summary: Agentic SDLC Automation for Regression Test Documentation.
description: As a QA Engineer, I want an Agentic SDLC workflow that retrieves Jira stories through Atlassian MCP and automatically generates SDLC artifacts, So that requirements, architecture, design review, implementation plan, code review, verification report and PR documentation are synchronized and traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: Jira story is retrieved through Atlassian MCP.
Approval gates exist between SDLC phases.
Pull Request can be created through GitHub MCP.
